_readme: Owner/admin answers to admin_decision_groups.xlsx (Phase G-DATA 1B.2), received as a screenshot with numbered answers. Recorded here verbatim (source_answer) plus the derived resolution applied by apply_admin_decisions_v5.py. Every SKU listed was explicitly covered by the owner's answer -- nothing here is inferred beyond what was said for SKUs not directly named within a group (e.g. base-unit / purchase-unit values applied to the full Topper family come from the owner's explicit 'A ya, 1 set = 1 pcs. 1 pack isi 12 pcs' answer to that named group).

TOPPER_SET_VS_PCS.source_answer: A ya, 1 set = 1 pcs. 1 pack isi 12 pcs
TOPPER_SET_VS_PCS.resolution: SET and PCS are the same countable unit (identity, factor 1). Purchase unit Pack = 12 Pcs (matches existing legacy data exactly).

PACK_VS_PCS.resolution: PACK contains the PCS count implied by each SKU's own product name; use it as the purchase conversion.

100503.note_only: Base unit is already PACK; '100 Pcs' is content of 1 Pack, not a further purchase layer.

SHEET_VS_PCS.resolution: SHEET and PCS are the same countable unit (identity). Purchase unit Pack = 500 Sheet/Pcs (matches legacy's 500 exactly).

ROLL_VS_PCS.source_answer: Strech film Betul 1 roll = 1 pcs. 1 ctn = 6 roll
ROLL_VS_PCS.resolution: ROLL and PCS are the same countable unit (identity). Purchase unit Ctn = 6 Roll/Pcs.

SET_VS_PCS.source_answer: Mika chiffon 1 set = 1 pcs . Per pack 250 pcs
SET_VS_PCS.resolution: SET and PCS are the same countable unit (identity). Purchase unit Pack = 250 Set/Pcs (matches legacy's 250 exactly).

333502.source_answer: Yang sticker bolu amor oval sekarang 1 lembarnya @50 pcs ya bu
333502.resolution: Owner gives an UPDATED authoritative count (50), superseding both the name-parsed value (43) and legacy's trivial default (1). 1 Lembar (sheet) = 50 Pcs.

555911.resolution: Confirms the name-derived count (250) over legacy's trivial default (1).

666201.resolution: Confirms the name-derived count (25) over legacy's trivial default (1).

100201.source_answer: Chefmate 1 ctn 10 kg kemasan yang 500 gr
100201.resolution: Confirms the CORRECTED parser's composite value (500gr x 20 = 10kg), not legacy's 20kg. 1 Ctn = 10 Kg for the 500gr-packaged Chefmate variant.

140541.source_answer: Creamfill classic banana 1 ctn isi 10 kg
140541.resolution: New authoritative value, overriding both legacy's trivial 1kg and the price-ratio-derived ~136x candidate. 1 Ctn = 10 Kg.

400111.resolution: Confirms the name evidence (2.7 kg content per piece) as correct; legacy's '2.7 Pcs' was a mislabeled unit (should have been Kg). This is a content-weight-per-piece fact, not a base-unit change -- base unit remains KG for inventory valuation.

900501.resolution: Confirms base unit is KG (matches legacy exactly, trivial factor 1); the name's 'Liter' mention is informal and not used as a real unit.
